package fixture

import (
	"context"

	"metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

// A generic resolver can be instantiated and passed where actorFromCtx is
// expected; its type parameters must not make the direct extraction invisible.
func badActorFromCtxGeneric[T any](ctx context.Context) (string, string, error) {
	_, err := tenant.FromContext(ctx)
	var zero T
	_ = zero
	return "", "", err
}
